To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the factors influencing social network usage/adoption by Pakistani SMEs are not static but dynamic in nature, and they change according to the changing environment of the SMEs.
the factors of PU (Perceived Usefulness), PEOU (Perceived Ease of Use), and Cost Effectiveness are the core influencing factors of the Facebook usage/adoption.

the perceived usefulness (increase in sales and increase in customers), perceived ease of use (smartphones and communication) and cost effectiveness of social media (Facebook) are the significant factors influencing Facebook usage or adoption by SMEs of Pakistan in the long run.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the factors influencing the usage or adoption of social media by the SMEs and their long-term durability.
the factors which are influencing Facebook adoption by SMEs in developing country i.e. Pakistan.
the robustness of the factors influencing Facebook usage or adoption by SMEs.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the factors influencing the usage of Facebook by the SME of Pakistan in the past are also the factors that are impacting the usage of Facebook in the long run by the SMEs.
the factors integrated with the TAM model are significantly impacting the Facebook usage/adoption presently and in the future.
the factors influencing social-media usage/adoption by SMEs are not only stable presently but in the long run as well.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
, the SMEs are using Facebook for increasing sales and customers and for communication purposes.
the factors that influence the Facebook usage/adoption are not only the factors of personal and organizational level, but the diffusion of digital devices also play a vital role.
the factors integrated to the model of TAM are still influencing the usage/adaption of social media by the SMEs and the factors will be influential in future as well.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the factors that have been found to be influential in the present scenario of social media usage by the SMEs are also found to be influential for future usage/adoption of social media.
the factors influencing Facebook adoption in the short run are not always the same factors that influence the adoption in the long run as well.
the SMEs should focus on those factors which are not only influential presently but also have the ability to remain influential in the long run as well.
